title: asq Office project plan
description: The body of GET /api/plan?project=<id> (data-contract.md §3 Plan, §4): the whole board for one project, todo/doing first, plus the latest manager note whose kind is plan. 404 no_such_project otherwise (error.json).

tasks.description: Every task on that project's board, todo/doing first.

note.description: The latest manager note of kind plan; markdown-ish text, not HTML.
